experiences.title: Network Engineer
experiences.description:
Managed enterprise network infrastructure across corporate offices, data centers, and hybrid cloud environments by administering network security, routing, switching, firewall policies, and secure remote connectivity, improving network availability by 30% while supporting business-critical financial applications.
Implemented IPsec VPN, SSL VPN, SD-WAN, and hybrid cloud connectivity across AWS and Azure environments to establish secure communication between enterprise locations and cloud workloads, reducing network disruptions by 35% and improving operational resilience.
Optimized network configuration management by reviewing firewall policies, access control rules, NAT configurations, and routing standards, reducing configuration complexity by 25% while strengthening security governance and regulatory compliance.
Monitored enterprise network health using SolarWinds, Splunk, SNMP, NetFlow, and packet analysis to proactively identify performance bottlenecks, latency issues, and abnormal network activity, reducing incident resolution time by 30% and improving service reliability.
Enhanced enterprise network operations by configuring BGP, OSPF, VLANs, Inter-VLAN Routing, QoS, High Availability, and network segmentation, improving application performance, traffic optimization, and business continuity across distributed environments.
Administered network configuration management, backup and recovery, firmware lifecycle management, and infrastructure maintenance across enterprise environments, improving operational stability by 25% while ensuring secure and highly available network services.
Performed network capacity planning, infrastructure health assessments, and performance optimization by analyzing utilization trends and network metrics, improving scalability and reducing recurring performance issues by 20%.
Improved network resilience and operational visibility by performing capacity planning, traffic analysis, and infrastructure health assessments, proactively identifying growth requirements and reducing unplanned network outages by 20% across enterprise environments.

experiences.title: Network Support Engineer
experiences.description:
Assisted in enterprise network and Windows Server administration by performing infrastructure upgrades, DNS/DHCP administration, Active Directory user provisioning, firmware updates, configuration management, and disaster recovery activities, improving system stability while supporting secure enterprise operations.
Configured VLANs, Inter-VLAN Routing, OSPF, BGP, and VPN connectivity to improve network traffic flow, strengthen secure enterprise communications, and enhance overall network performance by 20%.
Monitored enterprise network performance using SolarWinds, Wireshark, SNMP, and network monitoring tools to proactively identify bandwidth utilization, latency, and packet loss issues, reducing recurring network incidents by 25%.
Resolved network incidents through structured incident management, root cause analysis, and configuration updates, minimizing service disruptions and improving Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) by 30%.
Administered Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and user access management to maintain secure authentication, centralized access control, and reliable enterprise network operations.
Collaborated with infrastructure, security, and application support teams to perform change management, technical documentation, compliance validation, and operational support, improving service delivery efficiency while maintaining audit readiness.
